messages.author: Setyanto Md
messages.body:
Dear Amber User and Developer.
I'm reading in Amber tutorial for accelerated MD (
http://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial22/section1.htm
)
In 2nd stage, with name LET WATER MOVE. There is 1 flag : timlim = 999999.
I'm trying to look for about timlim in AMber 19 Manual, but can't find it.
Would you explain what is this flag about?
Thank you.
Setyanto Tri Wahyudi

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Aug 06, 2020, Setyanto Md wrote:
>In 2nd stage, with name LET WATER MOVE. There is 1 flag : timlim = 999999.
>I'm trying to look for about timlim in AMber 19 Manual, but can't find it.
This is the time limit in seconds for the job.  I didn't even know that was
still in the code.  With the value above, the job would abort after 12 days or
so.  It should quit cleanly, but I'd advise against counting on that.
Default is no time limit.  Generally better to use nstlim.
...dac
